Vulnerabilities.Title: Snappier has an infinite loop during SnappyStream decompression with malformed framed input
Vulnerabilities.Description: Snappier is a high performance C# implementation of the Snappy compression algorithm. Prior to 1.3.1, Snappier.SnappyStream enters an uncatchable infinite loop when decompressing a malformed framed-format Snappy stream as small as 15 bytes. This vulnerability is fixed in 1.3.1.
